meta.name: Magarsus
meta.description: Magarsus 1. sezon 1. bölüm full HD, Türkçe dublaj ve altyazılı izle 1080p izle. Halil Kurak, bölgede kurduğu iktidarına tehdit oluşturan Amerikalı Golden & Oran...

videos.title: Itibar
videos.overview: Halil is completely stalemated after the attacks of Fethi, the spectre haunting on Saribahçe. Things become more complicated after the moves of Tansu, Turgut and Beton while Halil makes an irreversible decision just before the festival.

videos.title: Dagilma
videos.overview: Nothing will be the same in Saribahce after Halil got shot. With the rise of the American company, Kurak Tarim begins to lose its power. Meanwhile, the successive moves of Fethi against the family are the runner of their falling apart.

videos.title: Manipulasyon
videos.overview: After Kurak's trap to hi, Erdem decides to play the game dirty. Turgut begins to get close to Damla while he is on a plan to overwhelm Erdem. But; a bad surprise for Turgut, a tough decision for Beton and a risky choice for Tansu await at the end.

videos.title: Secimler
videos.overview: The race for the chair of Citrus Union starts in Magarsus. Erdem and Beton, with the consultancy of Tansu, set traps to each other in their campaign. The minatory demand of Fethi wound the relationship of Beton and Turgut, fatally.

videos.title: Yolculuk
videos.overview: Tansu tries to protect Kurak Tarim against bans and oppression of Erdem under new era at Citrus Union meanwhile Beton and Turgut go on a journey that is full of confrontations, adventures and has serious results for everyone.

videos.title: Bedel
videos.overview: Turgut opts to fight with Fethi for redeeming himself to Damla. Tansu and Beton make a deal to keep Kurak Tarim alive against Erdem's moves. But, this deal and Turgut's decision upset the balance and lead everybody to the inevitable end.

videos.title: Savas
videos.overview: Magarsus' greatest war has begun. Because history repeats itself in Magarsus and the two princes of Magarsus came face to face again. In the middle of this war, Tansu has to make a difficult choice between her family and Saribahçe.

videos.title: Kuraklik
videos.overview: As the people of Saribahce prepare to face the drought, the economic crisis and the irreversible consequences of mining, each member of the Kurak family begins to implement their own plans, despite and against each other.

videos.title: Show Must Go On
videos.overview: As Turgut struggles with the traumas of his past and is on the verge of repeating old mistakes, Tansu and Beton are forced to make tough decisions as they struggle to survive and not lose power.

videos.title: Intikam
videos.overview: In order to keep their drug business afloat, Beton and Tansu try to use immigrants in difficult situations in exchange for a place to stay. However, they encounter situations they did not anticipate.

videos.title: Sikisma
videos.overview: While Beton, who is in negotiations with his secret partner, is strengthening his power, Tansu takes a step to protect his land.

videos.title: Cehennemde Gorusuruz
videos.overview: As Tansu and Turgut unexpectedly confront the secrets of the past, Beton feels anxious about the shadow following him.

videos.title: Kanli Topraklar
videos.overview: Shaken by the 1998 earthquake and the 2001 economic crisis, an empire was born in the early 2000s in the bloody land of Saribahce: Kurak Tarim.

videos.title: Yeni Saribahce
videos.overview: Turgut, Tansu and Beton are ready to do anything to win the municipal elections, but things get complicated because they all have a different method. With the support of the Americans, Hilmi emerges as a strong rival to Turgut.

videos.title: Biz Bir Aileyiz
videos.overview: Turgut's moves after being elected as mayor of Saribahce escalate the struggle between Tansu and Jessica. Tansu takes a big gamble to end the American presence in Saribahce.
